66326.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片上方兩格可見體積大、核圓、染色質細緻、具明顯核仁的非造血腫瘤細胞，細胞質灰藍並含空泡，其中一顆為雙核；下方切片可見骨小樑旁有多形性、深染的梭形至不規則核細胞浸潤，需以 desmin、myogenin 免疫染色確認為橫紋肌肉瘤（rhabdomyosarcoma）。
features: Top panels (aspirate): large atypical cells, several times the size of red cells, with round to oval nuclei and a binucleate/overlapping-nucleus form
Finely granular to vesicular chromatin with one or more distinct nucleoli
Moderate grey-blue cytoplasm with irregular frayed borders and cytoplasmic vacuoles
Cells occur singly without myeloid maturation features or granules
Bottom panel (trephine H&E): marrow replaced by pleomorphic hyperchromatic spindled to irregular cells in a loose fibrillary/edematous stroma adjacent to a bony trabecula
66326.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate contains large atypical non-hematopoietic-appearing cells with round nuclei, fine chromatin, prominent nucleoli and moderate vacuolated grey-blue cytoplasm, including a binucleate form. The accompanying trephine biopsy shows marrow spaces replaced by pleomorphic hyperchromatic spindled and irregular tumor cells in a loose stroma adjacent to bone trabeculae, without residual hematopoiesis in this field. The morphology indicates metastatic malignancy; with desmin, myogenin and MyoD1 positivity, findings are consistent with marrow involvement by rhabdomyosarcoma (alveolar type in this case).

ddx.dx: Acute leukemia (e.g., AML with monocytic or megakaryoblastic differentiation)
ddx.vs: Leukemic blasts are CD45+ and express myeloid markers on flow, while rhabdomyosarcoma cells are CD45− and desmin/myogenin positive, often forming cohesive clusters.

ddx.dx: Ewing sarcoma / other small round blue cell tumors
ddx.vs: Ewing cells are smaller and more monotonous with scant cytoplasm and are CD99/NKX2.2 positive with EWSR1 rearrangement rather than myogenin positive.
Carcinoma forms cohesive epithelial clusters and is cytokeratin positive and desmin/myogenin negative.

ddx.dx: Alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma mimicking hematolymphoid neoplasm (CD56/CD19 expression)
ddx.vs: Aberrant CD56 or CD19 on flow can mislead, so a CD45-negative gate should prompt myogenin/MyoD1 staining and FOXO1 rearrangement testing.

65814.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片白血球極度增加，同一視野就看到從前骨髓細胞、骨髓細胞、後骨髓細胞、帶狀核到分節嗜中性球的完整成熟階段（「骨髓樣」血液），且原始細胞不多、血小板偏多，這是 CML 慢性期的典型表現。
features: Marked leukocytosis with virtually no gaps between white cells and red cells
Full spectrum of granulocytic maturation: promyelocytes, numerous myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils
Myelocyte and neutrophil peak (myelocyte bulge) without a significant blast population in this field
Immature cells with round to indented nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin and lilac granular cytoplasm; no dysplastic hypogranulation
Numerous platelets in the background; red cells normocytic with central pallor
65814.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked leukocytosis composed of granulocytes at all stages of maturation. Myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils predominate, with occasional promyelocytes; blasts are not increased in this field and granulocytes show no significant dysplasia. Platelets appear increased and red cells are normocytic and normochromic. Findings are consistent with chronic myeloid leukemia, BCR::ABL1-positive, chronic phase, in the appropriate molecular context.

ddx.vs: A leukemoid reaction shows toxic granulation and Dohle bodies with a left shift dominated by bands and metamyelocytes, fewer myelocytes, no basophilia, and a high LAP score.
aCML shows prominent granulocytic dysplasia (hypogranulation, pseudo-Pelger nuclei) and lacks basophilia, whereas maturation here is orderly.
CNL consists predominantly of mature segmented neutrophils with immature granulocytes under 10%, unlike the myelocyte-rich picture here.
Leukoerythroblastosis includes nucleated red cells and teardrop cells with a lower white count.

exam.answer_en: Chronic myeloid leukemia, BCR::ABL1-positive, chronic phase — marked leukocytosis with full granulocytic maturation and myelocyte peak
pearls_zh: 考法：整片白血球從前骨髓細胞到分節球都有，考官會問「數一數哪兩個峰」：myelocyte 與成熟嗜中性球雙峰，母細胞少，並要主動找嗜鹼性球。
遺傳：t(9;22)(q34.1;q11.2) Philadelphia chromosome，BCR::ABL1 多為 p210；診斷以 karyotype、FISH 或 RT-PCR 確認，RQ-PCR（IS）用於追蹤。
治療反應里程碑（ELN）：BCR::ABL1 IS ≤10% 於 3 個月、≤1% 於 6 個月、≤0.1%（MMR）於 12 個月；T315I 突變對多數 TKI 抗藥，可用 ponatinib 或 asciminib。
分期：WHO 5th 取消 accelerated phase，僅分 chronic 與 blast phase（母細胞 ≥20%、髓外母細胞增生或淋巴母細胞增加）；ICC 2022 仍保留 AP（母細胞 10–19%、嗜鹼性球 ≥20% 等）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常被誤認為 leukemoid reaction：類白血病反應有 toxic granulation/Döhle bodies、以帶狀核與後骨髓細胞為主、無嗜鹼性球增多、LAP score 高；CML 則 LAP 低並有 myelocyte bulge。

quiz.q: 這張白血球極多、各階段顆粒球都有的血片最可能診斷？確認診斷的必要檢查為何？
quiz.a: CML chronic phase；證明 BCR::ABL1（Ph chromosome karyotype、FISH 或 RT-PCR）

65622.recognize_zh: 低倍 MPO 免疫染色可見 MPO 陽性顆粒球系細胞集中在骨小樑旁形成寬帶，而骨小樑間區域以 MPO 陰性小細胞為主、散在陽性成熟嗜中性球很少，顯示顆粒球生成停滯於未成熟階段，符合先天性嚴重嗜中性球低下。
features: MPO IHC on bone marrow trephine at low power
Broad paratrabecular band of MPO-positive large immature granulocytic cells along the bony trabecula
Small perivascular/interstitial clusters of MPO-positive immature cells
Intertrabecular marrow dominated by MPO-negative small round cells with interspersed fat
Relatively few scattered small MPO-positive mature neutrophils
65622.describe_en: Low-power myeloperoxidase immunostain of the bone marrow trephine demonstrates granulocytic cells concentrated in a broad paratrabecular band of large MPO-positive immature forms, with a few small interstitial clusters. The intertrabecular marrow is composed largely of MPO-negative small cells (erythroid precursors and lymphocytes) with interspersed adipocytes, and mature MPO-positive segmented neutrophils are relatively scant. This distribution reflects preserved early granulopoiesis with impaired maturation to segmented neutrophils. In a child with a pathogenic ELANE variant on G-CSF, findings are consistent with severe congenital neutropenia with maturation arrest.

ddx.dx: Normal pediatric marrow with left-shifted granulopoiesis
ddx.vs: Normal marrow shows paratrabecular immature forms maturing toward the intertrabecular space with abundant MPO-positive segmented neutrophils.
Leukemic blasts replace the marrow diffusely without paratrabecular organization, and are often CD34+ with variable or weak MPO.
Shows hypocellular marrow with dysplasia, pancreatic insufficiency and SBDS mutations, rather than isolated promyelocyte-stage arrest with ELANE variant.

65238.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片細胞量明顯增加，脂肪減少，可見大量顆粒球與紅血球系前驅細胞及散在的巨核細胞；形態本身屬高細胞性骨髓的非特異表現，需配合抹片前驅細胞空泡與 UBA1 突變判讀為 VEXAS。
features: Hypercellular marrow with reduced fat for age
Expanded granulocytic and erythroid precursors with preserved trilineage hematopoiesis
Scattered megakaryocytes, some large with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm
Interstitial small lymphocytes and plasma cells
No sheets of blasts or foreign cell clusters; precursor vacuoles are not reliably assessable on H&E
65238.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy is hypercellular for age with expanded granulocytic and erythroid precursors and scattered megakaryocytes, some large. Trilineage hematopoiesis is present without sheets of blasts, granulomas, or metastatic tumor. Cytoplasmic vacuolization of precursors, the key morphologic clue, is better evaluated on the aspirate smear than on this H&E section. In a patient with a UBA1 p.Met41Leu variant and vacuolated precursors on the aspirate, findings are consistent with the hypercellular marrow of VEXAS syndrome.

ddx.vs: MDS may be hypercellular with dysplastic megakaryocytes; UBA1 sequencing and clinical inflammatory features separate VEXAS.
MPNs show clustered atypical megakaryocytes with fibrosis and driver mutations (JAK2/CALR/MPL) rather than scattered megakaryocytes.
Morphology overlaps completely on H&E; the distinction relies on aspirate vacuoles and UBA1 mutation.

65302.recognize_zh: 淋巴球增多，細胞質量從少到豐富不等，部分偏漿細胞樣（核偏位），核形不規則、可見切跡，左下有破碎的 smudge cell；這些不典型特徵常見於 CLL 伴 trisomy 12。
features: Increased small-to-medium lymphocytes with variable cytoplasmic volume
Several cells with abundant pale cytoplasm and eccentric, plasmacytoid-appearing nuclei
Irregular, notched and focally cleaved nuclear outlines
Moderately condensed chromatin; no prominent nucleoli
Smudge cell at lower left
Normochromic red cells without significant poikilocytosis
65302.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows lymphocytosis composed of small to medium-sized lymphocytes. Many cells have more abundant cytoplasm than typical CLL cells, some with an eccentric plasmacytoid nuclear position, and nuclear contours are irregular to cleaved with moderately condensed chromatin. Smudge cells are present and prolymphocytes are not prominent. The findings are consistent with atypical CLL morphology associated with trisomy 12, pending immunophenotypic confirmation.

ddx.vs: Plasmacytoid cells raise LPL, which is usually CD5-negative/CD23-negative with an IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P.
MCL is separated by cyclin D1/SOX11 positivity, CD23 negativity and t(11;14).
SMZL cells show polar villous projections and lack CD5/CD23 co-expression.

65174.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中大型、多形性的腫瘤細胞，細胞質含嗜鹼性/異染性顆粒與空泡，並見吞噬現象；切片為破壞性片狀浸潤、含多核巨細胞，tryptase 瀰漫陽性，流式 CD117+/CD25+，指向高度惡性的肥大細胞肉瘤。
features: Peripheral blood: atypical circulating cell with irregular nucleus and coarse purple cytoplasmic granules
Aspirate: large pleomorphic cells with abundant cytoplasm containing metachromatic granules, vacuoles, and multinucleated/bizarre forms; hemophagocytosis present
Biopsy: destructive diffuse sheets of large pleomorphic cells with pale to eosinophilic cytoplasm and scattered multinucleated tumor giant cells
Tryptase immunostain diffusely positive in the tumor sheets
Flow cytometry (CD117-gated): CD33 positive, variable HLA-DR, aberrant CD25 expression
65174.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows rare atypical circulating cells with coarse cytoplasmic granules. The bone marrow aspirate contains large, pleomorphic cells with abundant granulated and vacuolated cytoplasm, including multinucleated forms, along with hemophagocytosis. The core biopsy shows a destructive diffuse infiltrate of highly atypical cells with scattered tumor giant cells that are diffusely positive for tryptase, and flow cytometry shows CD117-positive cells with aberrant CD25 expression. Findings are consistent with a high-grade mast cell neoplasm; with the destructive growth pattern and marked cytologic atypia, mast cell sarcoma involving the bone marrow is favored.

ddx.vs: MCL shows ≥20% mast cells on aspirate, typically less pleomorphic immature cells without a destructive mass-like growth, whereas mast cell sarcoma is defined by high-grade cytology and localized destructive growth.
Basophilic blasts are smaller with coarse basophilic granules and are CD123/CD203c positive but tryptase-low and CD117 negative/dim, whereas these cells are strongly tryptase and CD117 positive.
Histiocytic sarcoma shows large pleomorphic cells expressing CD163/CD68 and lacks tryptase and CD117.
ALCL is also CD30 positive and pleomorphic but expresses T-cell markers and lacks cytoplasmic metachromatic granules and tryptase.

65110.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 H&E 40 倍：出血背景中散布許多大型細胞，核圓至卵圓、染色質呈泡狀、核仁明顯、細胞質雙嗜性，與小而深染的紅血球系前驅細胞混雜，並見有絲分裂，這些大型細胞即 plasmablasts。
features: Numerous large cells with round to oval vesicular nuclei and distinct nucleoli
Moderate amphophilic to lightly eosinophilic cytoplasm, some cells slightly plasmacytoid
Scattered interstitial distribution without cohesive clusters
Occasional mitotic figure
Admixed small dark erythroid precursors and granulocytes; hemorrhagic background with fat spaces
65110.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E, 40x) shows a cellular marrow with a prominent interstitial population of large cells containing round to oval vesicular nuclei, distinct nucleoli and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm, with an occasional mitotic figure. These cells are admixed with residual erythroid precursors and granulocytic cells in a hemorrhagic background. No cohesive epithelial clusters or granulomas are seen. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by plasmablasts in HHV8-associated multicentric Castleman disease; LANA-1, CD138, MUM1 and light-chain immunostains are needed to confirm and to exclude HHV8-positive large B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.dx: HHV8-positive diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS
ddx.vs: Lymphoma forms confluent sheets of LANA-1-positive plasmablasts replacing marrow, rather than scattered interstitial cells among preserved hematopoiesis.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell myeloma with plasmablastic morphology
ddx.vs: Myeloma is CD138-positive with a serum/urine paraprotein, whereas MCD plasmablasts are often CD138-negative, HHV8-positive and IgM lambda.
Proerythroblasts are E-cadherin/glycophorin-positive and form erythroid colonies with maturing forms, unlike MUM1-positive plasmablasts.
Carcinoma forms cohesive clusters with desmoplasia and is cytokeratin-positive, whereas these cells are discohesive and lymphoid.

65046.recognize_zh: 兩顆分葉核嗜中性球的核葉旁各有一個小圓形染色質團，以一條細絲與主核相連（紅箭頭），形似鼓槌，就是女性不活化 X 染色體所形成的鼓槌小體（drumstick）。
features: Two mature segmented neutrophils with fine lilac cytoplasmic granules
Small (about 1.5 µm), round, dense chromatin appendage attached to a nuclear lobe by a thin chromatin strand (red arrows)
Appendage has a solid, well-defined head (drumstick) rather than a hollow or unattached body
Background red cells normocytic with a few target cells and stomatocyte-like forms; platelets present
65046.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two mature segmented neutrophils, each bearing a small round, densely staining nuclear appendage connected to a nuclear lobe by a fine chromatin filament. The appendages have a solid head consistent with drumsticks (sex chromatin, Barr body equivalent). Red cells show a few target cells but no other significant abnormality. Findings are consistent with neutrophil drumsticks, a normal finding in females representing the inactivated X chromosome.

ddx.vs: Sessile nodules lack a thin stalk and lie directly on the lobe, and are not counted as drumsticks.
Racquets have a hollow, pale-centered head, unlike the solid dense head of a drumstick.
Hypersegmentation shows six or more full-size lobes rather than a single small appendage.
Döhle bodies are pale blue cytoplasmic patches and platelets are granular and not connected to the nucleus by a chromatin thread.

exam.answer_en: Drumsticks — small round chromatin appendages attached by a thin strand to neutrophil nuclear lobes (inactive X chromosome, female)
pearls_zh: 考法：指紅箭頭的核附屬物問名稱與意義，答 drumstick，代表 inactive X chromosome（中性球版的 Barr body），見於女性。
性染色體關聯：drumstick 數量與 X 染色體數目相關，Klinefelter syndrome（47,XXY）男性可見，Turner syndrome（45,X）則通常缺乏。
判讀要點：須有實心、界線清楚的圓頭並以細絲連接核葉；中空的 racquet form、無細絲的 sessile nodule 或小棒狀突起不算 drumstick。
臨床用途多屬歷史/教學性（性別判定已由 karyotype 或分子檢測取代），但 allogeneic HSCT 後異性捐贈者嵌合狀態曾以此輔助評估。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 hypersegmentation 的小核葉、Howell-Jolly body 或附著血小板混淆；drumstick 以細絲連在核葉上、頭部約 1.5 µm 實心深染，血小板則在細胞外且帶紫色顆粒。

quiz.q: 紅箭頭所指嗜中性球核葉上以細絲相連的小圓團叫什麼？代表哪條染色體？
quiz.a: Drumstick；inactive X chromosome（女性）。

64726.recognize_zh: A 圖骨髓抹片中一個巨大的原紅血球（giant pronormoblast），細胞質深藍、邊緣有空泡，核染色質淡而呈玻璃樣並有核內包涵體；B 圖切片中紅系前驅細胞有嗜酸性核內病毒包涵體；C 圖紅系明顯減少、D 圖少數細胞 parvovirus B19 核染色陽性。
features: Panel A: giant erythroid precursor (pronormoblast) with deeply basophilic, vacuolated cytoplasm and a large nucleus with pale glassy chromatin and inclusion-like areas
Background of granulocytic precursors with myeloid predominance and scarce maturing erythroid cells
Panel B: hypocellular fatty marrow with an erythroid precursor bearing an intranuclear inclusion with peripheral chromatin margination (arrow)
Panel C: spectrin IHC showing markedly reduced erythroid cells
Panel D: rare cell with strong nuclear parvovirus B19 immunostaining
64726.describe_en: Composite figure of bone marrow studies. The aspirate smear (A) shows myeloid predominance with a markedly reduced, left-shifted erythroid series, including a giant pronormoblast with deeply basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm and a nucleus containing pale, glassy intranuclear inclusions. The core biopsy (B) is fatty and shows an erythroid precursor with an eosinophilic intranuclear inclusion and marginated chromatin (arrow). Spectrin immunostaining (C) confirms significantly reduced erythroid cells, and parvovirus B19 immunohistochemistry (D) highlights nuclear staining in rare erythroid precursors. Findings are consistent with parvovirus B19 infection causing erythroid hypoplasia with maturation arrest.

ddx.vs: PEL shows sheets of erythroid blasts constituting ≥80% of marrow cells, whereas here erythroid cells are markedly decreased with only rare giant pronormoblasts.
Megaloblastic change shows erythroid hyperplasia with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony and giant bands, not erythroid hypoplasia with viral intranuclear inclusions.

ddx.dx: Therapy-related or immune pure red cell aplasia (e.g., thymoma, drug)
ddx.vs: Non-viral PRCA lacks giant pronormoblasts with inclusions and is negative for parvovirus B19 by IHC and PCR.
Regeneration shows synchronous left-shifted clusters of normal-sized erythroid precursors without intranuclear inclusions or B19 staining.

64726.stain: Wright-Giemsa; H&E; IHC: spectrin, parvovirus B19

exam.answer_en: Parvovirus B19 infection of marrow — giant pronormoblasts with intranuclear inclusions and erythroid hypoplasia, B19 IHC positive
pearls_zh: 考法：指 A 圖的巨大原紅血球（giant pronormoblast）問「想到什麼病毒？」——答 parvovirus B19；病毒以紅系前驅細胞上的 P antigen（globoside）為受體。
臨床三型：慢性溶血病人（如 HS、sickle cell）發生 transient aplastic crisis；免疫低下者（化療、移植、骨髓瘤治療中）形成慢性 pure red cell aplasia；孕婦感染致 hydrops fetalis。
實驗室關鍵：網狀紅血球幾乎為零；免疫低下者抗體反應差，血清學可能陰性，應以血中 B19 DNA PCR 或骨髓 IHC 確認。
治療：免疫低下者的慢性 PRCA 可用 IVIG，並盡量減輕免疫抑制。
exam.pitfall_zh: 巨大原紅血球易被誤認為 pure erythroid leukemia 的母細胞；B19 是散在少數巨大細胞、背景紅系明顯減少並有核內包涵體，白血病則是成片紅系母細胞。

quiz.q: 病人網狀紅血球極低，骨髓出現圖 A 這種巨大原紅血球並有核內包涵體，最可能的病因與確認檢查為何？
quiz.a: Parvovirus B19 感染；血中 B19 DNA PCR 或骨髓 parvovirus B19 IHC

64662.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中大量大型原始細胞，核圓、染色質細緻，細胞質深藍色並有明顯的細胞質泡狀突起（blebs），部分有小空泡，形態符合原紅血球（proerythroblasts），提示純紅血球白血病（acute erythroid leukemia）。
features: Numerous large blasts with high N:C ratio and round, centrally to eccentrically placed nuclei
Finely dispersed chromatin with inconspicuous to small nucleoli
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm with prominent cytoplasmic blebs/pseudopod-like projections
Occasional small cytoplasmic vacuoles; no Auer rods or azurophilic granules
Scattered mature neutrophils and cells with coarse pink-magenta granules; few maturing erythroid forms
64662.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a predominance of large blasts with high N:C ratios, round nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin and small nucleoli, and deeply basophilic cytoplasm with prominent cytoplasmic blebs and occasional small vacuoles. Auer rods and cytoplasmic granules are absent in the blasts. Scattered neutrophils and granulated myeloid cells are present, with few maturing erythroid precursors. Morphology is consistent with proerythroblasts, and in conjunction with reported >30% proerythroblasts, complex karyotype and TP53 mutation, findings support acute erythroid leukemia (pure erythroid leukemia); immunophenotyping (E-cadherin, CD71, glycophorin A, CD117) is required for lineage confirmation.

ddx.vs: Megakaryoblasts also show basophilic cytoplasmic blebs but express CD41/CD61 and lack E-cadherin/CD71 and glycophorin, so immunophenotyping is required to separate them.
Parvovirus pronormoblasts are giant, sparse cells with intranuclear viral inclusions in an otherwise erythroid-hypoplastic marrow, not sheets of blasts with complex karyotype and TP53 mutation.
Megaloblastic marrow shows a full spectrum of maturing erythroid cells with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony and giant metamyelocytes, rather than an arrest at the proerythroblast stage.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round blue cell tumor (e.g., neuroblastoma, rhabdomyosarcoma)
ddx.vs: Tumor cells form cohesive clumps or rosettes and lack erythroid markers, whereas these blasts are dispersed single cells.

exam.answer_en: Acute erythroid leukemia (pure erythroid) — sheets of proerythroblasts with deeply basophilic, blebbed and vacuolated cytoplasm
pearls_zh: 考法：指深藍細胞質有泡狀突起的大母細胞問「什麼系？」——答 proerythroblast；外觀像 megakaryoblast，需免疫表型判別系別。
診斷門檻：WHO 5th 的 acute erythroid leukemia 為紅系前驅細胞 ≥80% 且其中 proerythroblasts ≥30%；ICC 2022 將多數病例歸入 AML with mutated TP53。
免疫表型：E-cadherin、CD71、CD117 陽性，早期細胞 glycophorin A 可為陰性；細胞化學 PAS 常呈塊狀陽性、MPO 陰性。
遺傳與預後：高度相關於 complex karyotype 與 TP53（常為多重打擊）突變，預後極差。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常與 acute megakaryoblastic leukemia 混淆，兩者都有細胞質泡狀突起；以 CD41/CD61（巨核系）對比 E-cadherin/CD71（紅系）區分。

quiz.q: 這些細胞質深藍、有泡狀突起的母細胞若為紅系，WHO 5th 診斷 acute erythroid leukemia 需要哪兩個比例條件？
quiz.a: 紅系前驅細胞 ≥80%，且 proerythroblasts ≥30%

64534.recognize_zh: 一顆柱狀上皮細胞，一端有明顯的終板（terminal bar）與成束的纖毛，另一端為圓形細胞核，背景有細菌與黏液碎屑，符合鼻腔分泌物中的纖毛柱狀上皮細胞。
features: Single large columnar epithelial cell, much larger than surrounding debris
Round to oval nucleus with finely granular chromatin and small nucleoli, positioned at one pole
Moderate pale blue-violet cytoplasm tapering toward the apical end
Apical tuft of cilia attached to a terminal plate, stained pink-violet
Background of scattered bacteria and mucoid debris; no inflammatory cells in this field
64534.describe_en: Smear of nasal secretions shows a single intact columnar epithelial cell in a background of mucoid debris and scattered bacteria. The cell has a basally placed round nucleus with finely granular chromatin and a small nucleolus, pale blue cytoplasm, and an apical terminal plate bearing a tuft of cilia. No atypia is present. Findings are consistent with a benign ciliated respiratory epithelial cell.

ddx.vs: Trichomonads are smaller pear-shaped organisms with an anterior flagellar tuft and undulating membrane, lacking a terminal bar and a large epithelial-type nucleus.
Ciliocytophthoria shows anucleate ciliated tufts separated from degenerating cells, whereas here the cilia remain attached to an intact nucleated cell.
Squamous cells are flat and polygonal with a small central pyknotic nucleus and no cilia or terminal plate.

64470.recognize_zh: 低倍下關節液抹片細胞量極多，除了帶粉紅顆粒、分葉核的中性球外，還夾雜大量體積較大、細胞質深藍、核圓而染色質細緻的芽細胞，符合 AML 浸潤關節液。
features: Highly cellular fluid preparation with numerous nucleated cells and only rare red cells
Population of larger round blasts with high N:C ratio, round nuclei and deeply basophilic agranular cytoplasm
Admixed neutrophils and band forms with pink granular cytoplasm and lobulated nuclei
Some blasts form loose clusters; no cohesive epithelial-type groups
Lower magnification limits assessment of chromatin detail and Auer rods
64470.describe_en: Cytocentrifuge preparation of left knee joint fluid at low magnification is markedly cellular. It contains a mixture of neutrophils and bands with a substantial population of larger blasts that have round nuclei, high N:C ratios, and deeply basophilic agranular cytoplasm, occurring singly and in loose clusters. Chromatin detail and cytoplasmic inclusions cannot be fully assessed at this magnification. Findings are consistent with involvement of the joint fluid by acute myeloid leukemia, supported by flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: Septic effusions are overwhelmingly neutrophilic and lack a separate population of large basophilic blasts.

ddx.dx: Blood contamination of a traumatic tap in a leukemic patient
ddx.vs: Contamination would bring abundant red cells, whereas this sample has very few red cells relative to the blast population.
Lymphoma cells lack myeloid antigen expression and are accompanied by lymphocytes rather than maturing granulocytes; flow cytometry separates them.

64150.recognize_zh: 中央可見一顆比周圍紅血球大、顏色淡的受感染紅血球，內有散布的細小褐色顆粒（色素／Schüffner 點狀）與一個小型染色質點，符合間日瘧（P. vivax）感染；但染色偏淡，典型成熟配子體（gametocyte）的形態在此圖中不易明確判定。
features: Central parasitized red cell enlarged relative to surrounding red cells, with pale, irregular outline
Fine brown granules dispersed throughout the host cell (pigment and/or Schüffner-type stippling)
Small eccentric ring-like chromatin dot within the infected cell
Background red cells show crenation (echinocytic artifact); several platelets and a small granular platelet clump
Weak, washed-out staining limits staging of the parasite
64150.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows red cells with prominent crenation artifact and scattered platelets. One enlarged, pale red cell contains dispersed fine brown granules and a small eccentric chromatin dot, compatible with a Plasmodium vivax-infected erythrocyte; the enlargement of the host cell and stippling favor P. vivax over P. falciparum. Because of the pale staining, a mature gametocyte (round parasite filling the cell with a single compact chromatin mass and dispersed pigment) cannot be confidently distinguished from a developing trophozoite in this field. Findings are suggestive of P. vivax malaria; correlation with a thick film and a well-stained thin film is recommended.

ddx.vs: P. falciparum infects normal-sized red cells without Schüffner dots and shows banana-shaped (crescentic) gametocytes rather than round gametocytes in enlarged cells.
P. ovale also enlarges red cells with Schüffner dots, but infected cells are oval with fimbriated edges; species confirmation may require PCR.
A superimposed platelet shows purple granules without a chromatin dot, does not enlarge the red cell, and lies in a different focal plane.

64022.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片（B、C）幾乎被深藍色胞質、細緻染色質並有核仁的原紅血球（proerythroblast）佔滿，PAS（E）呈粗顆粒狀陽性、CD71（G）大片膜染色，而MPO（D）只有少數細胞陽性，指向純紅血球白血病（pure erythroid leukemia）。
features: Bone marrow aspirate dominated by large immature erythroid precursors (proerythroblasts) with round nuclei, fine chromatin, visible nucleoli and deeply basophilic, focally vacuolated cytoplasm
Relative paucity of maturing granulocytes; scattered later-stage erythroid precursors present
PAS stain shows coarse granular/dot-like cytoplasmic positivity in abnormal erythroid cells
MPO stain positive only in scattered cells, not in the predominant blast population
Hypercellular trephine with sheets of immature cells; CD71 shows extensive membranous staining of the erythroid population
CD41 highlights megakaryocytes including small hypolobated forms; peripheral blood contains occasional blasts and nucleated red cells
64022.describe_en: Composite figure. The peripheral blood smear shows occasional circulating immature cells and nucleated red blood cells. The bone marrow aspirate is markedly hypercellular and dominated by proerythroblasts with deeply basophilic, vacuolated cytoplasm, round nuclei and nucleoli; myeloperoxidase is positive only in scattered myeloid cells, while PAS shows coarse granular positivity in the abnormal erythroid cells. The trephine biopsy shows sheets of immature cells that are extensively CD71-positive, and CD41 highlights dysplastic, including small hypolobated, megakaryocytes. Findings are consistent with pure erythroid leukemia (acute erythroid leukemia), pending quantification of erythroid precursors and proerythroblasts and TP53/cytogenetic studies.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic marrow shows orderly full-spectrum erythroid maturation with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony and giant metamyelocytes rather than sheets of proerythroblasts, and corrects with vitamin replacement.

ddx.dx: AML with myelodysplasia-related changes / MDS with erythroid predominance
ddx.vs: Erythroid cells are mostly maturing forms and the blast count is based on MPO-positive myeloblasts, without the >80% erythroid and >=30% proerythroblast composition of pure erythroid leukemia.
Blasts with basophilic blebbing cytoplasm can look similar, but they express CD41/CD61 rather than CD71/E-cadherin/glycophorin.

ddx.dx: Lymphoma or small round blue cell tumor infiltrating marrow
ddx.vs: Deeply basophilic vacuolated cells may mimic Burkitt cells or metastatic tumor, but CD71/E-cadherin positivity and PAS granular staining establish erythroid lineage.

64022.stain: Wright-Giemsa, MPO, PAS, H&E, IHC: CD71, CD41

exam.answer_en: Pure erythroid leukemia — sheets of vacuolated basophilic proerythroblasts, coarse granular PAS positivity, MPO-negative, CD71-positive
pearls_zh: 考法：組合圖依序判讀：MPO 只染殘存骨髓細胞（腫瘤細胞陰性）、PAS 粗顆粒陽性、biopsy CD71 成片陽性，三者合起來證明是紅血球系。
WHO 5th 稱 AML with erythroid differentiation：erythroid precursors ≥80% 且 proerythroblasts ≥30%；舊的 erythroid/myeloid 型已取消，依 myeloblast 比例改歸 MDS 或 AML。
與 TP53 密切相關：常見 TP53 突變與 complex karyotype；ICC 2022 將具 TP53 突變者歸入 AML with mutated TP53；整體預後極差。
紅血球系 IHC：CD71、E-cadherin 標示早期前驅細胞；glycophorin A/C 與 hemoglobin 多在較成熟階段才陽性，最原始的 proerythroblast 可能陰性。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 megakaryoblastic leukemia、Burkitt 或非造血小圓細胞腫瘤：megakaryoblast 為 CD41/CD61 陽性（本例 CD41 只標出散在發育異常巨核細胞）；腫瘤細胞 CD71 成片陽性才支持紅血球系。

quiz.q: 本組合圖中哪兩個染色結果支持異常細胞屬紅血球系而非 myeloblast？
quiz.a: MPO 陰性（僅殘存骨髓細胞陽性）且 CD71 成片陽性（PAS 粗顆粒陽性亦支持）。

63958.recognize_zh: 四格對照圖：1A/1B（室溫處理）紅血球分布均勻、形態大致正常；2A/2B（檢體置 4 °C 後）低倍可見紅血球聚成不規則團塊（autoagglutination），高倍紅血球互相重疊成群並伴皺縮，提示冷凝集素造成的凝集。
features: Composite of four peripheral blood smear panels labeled 1A, 1B, 2A, 2B
1A-1B: evenly dispersed red cells with largely normal shape; a segmented neutrophil in 1B
2A (after 4 C incubation): low-power irregular clumping of red cells into agglutinates with uneven distribution
2B: red cells in overlapping irregular clusters, many crenated (echinocytic) cells, limiting morphologic assessment
Scattered platelets in all panels; no rouleaux stacking pattern
63958.describe_en: This composite shows peripheral blood smears prepared before (1A, 1B) and after (2A, 2B) incubation of the sample at 4 C. The initial smears show evenly spread red cells with essentially unremarkable morphology at low and high power. After cold incubation, the low-power view shows irregular three-dimensional red cell clumps, and the high-power view shows overlapping clusters of red cells with crenation, obscuring fine red cell morphology. The cold-dependent red cell agglutination, in the setting of macrocytic hemolytic anemia and acrocyanosis, is suggestive of cold agglutinin disease, to be confirmed by a positive C3d direct antiglobulin test and cold agglutinin titer.

ddx.vs: Rouleaux form linear stacks like coins that disperse with saline, whereas agglutinates are irregular grape-like clusters that persist with saline and reverse on warming.
Warm AIHA shows spherocytes with an IgG-positive DAT and no temperature-dependent clumping.
PCH is caused by a biphasic IgG Donath-Landsteiner antibody, usually in children, and typically shows erythrophagocytosis rather than prominent agglutination.
Artifactual echinocytes are evenly distributed and not clustered, and they do not appear only after cold exposure of the sample.

exam.answer_en: Cold agglutinin disease — cold-dependent RBC autoagglutination (clumps appear after 4 °C incubation, absent at room temperature)
pearls_zh: 考法：四格溫度對照圖問「為什麼冷藏後紅血球成團」；答冷凝集素（通常 IgM，多為 anti-I）造成的 autoagglutination，並指出此為體外可逆現象。
血球計數假象：紅血球計數與 Hct 假性下降、MCV 與 MCHC 假性上升；將檢體預溫至 37 °C 後重測可校正。
確認檢查：DAT 為 C3d 陽性、IgG 通常陰性，加上冷凝集素效價；primary CAD 常有骨髓中克隆性 B 細胞增生，需檢查單株 IgM（多為 kappa）。
次發原因：Mycoplasma pneumoniae（anti-I）、EBV（anti-i）、淋巴瘤；治療以保暖、rituximab 為主，complement C1s 抑制劑 sutimlimab 可用於 CAD，類固醇效果差。
exam.pitfall_zh: 紅血球成團易被誤認為 rouleaux；rouleaux 為像硬幣疊成直線串、見於高蛋白血症且預溫不消失，凝集則是不規則立體團塊、加溫至 37 °C 可散開。

quiz.q: 檢體冷藏後紅血球聚成不規則團塊，DAT 預期呈何種型態？此現象會使 MCV 如何變化？
quiz.a: C3d 陽性（IgG 通常陰性）；MCV 與 MCHC 假性上升（預溫 37 °C 可校正）

63766.recognize_zh: G 顯帶核型圖中第 12 號染色體有三條（紅色箭頭），其餘染色體與 X、Y 各一條，判讀為 47,XY,+12；三染色體 12 是 CLL 常見的細胞遺傳異常。
features: G-banded karyogram of a single metaphase arranged by chromosome number
Three copies of chromosome 12 (red arrow) — trisomy 12
One X and one Y chromosome (male)
No other numerical or overt structural abnormalities apparent at this band resolution
Interpretation: 47,XY,+12
63766.describe_en: This is a G-banded karyogram rather than a morphologic image. It shows 47 chromosomes with an extra copy of chromosome 12 (arrow) in a male karyotype, with no other obvious numerical or structural abnormalities at this band resolution. The karyotype is interpreted as 47,XY,+12. In chronic lymphocytic leukemia, trisomy 12 is an intermediate-risk cytogenetic lesion associated with atypical morphology and phenotype and NOTCH1 mutations; the concurrent 13q14 deletion was detected by FISH, which is more sensitive than conventional karyotype for CLL.

63638.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片細胞量豐富，左側可見一顆細胞核分成兩個分離圓核的巨核細胞（separated nuclear lobes），上方有雙核紅血球母細胞，並有核分裂像及大量晚期正染紅血球母細胞，這些發育不良（dysplasia）線索符合 MDS/MPN 伴環狀鐵粒母細胞與血小板增多的骨髓。
features: Megakaryocyte (left) with two widely separated round nuclei and granular cytoplasm, a dysplastic megakaryocytic feature
Binucleated erythroid precursor (upper center) with basophilic cytoplasm, indicating dyserythropoiesis
Erythroid-rich background with numerous orthochromatic and polychromatic normoblasts
Mitotic figure in a large precursor (center right)
Maturing granulocytes including myelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils; no increase in blasts evident in this field
63638.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is cellular with trilineage hematopoiesis and prominent erythroid precursors across all stages of maturation. A megakaryocyte with two widely separated round nuclei and a binucleated erythroid precursor are present, indicating megakaryocytic and erythroid dysplasia; a mitotic figure is also seen. Granulocytic maturation is present and blasts are not increased in this field. Findings are suggestive of a myelodysplastic process and, together with ring sideroblasts and thrombocytosis, are consistent with myelodysplastic/myeloproliferative neoplasm with ring sideroblasts and thrombocytosis; an iron stain is required to quantify ring sideroblasts.

ddx.dx: MDS with ring sideroblasts / SF3B1 mutation
ddx.vs: MDS-RS shares the dyserythropoiesis and ring sideroblasts but lacks the large MPN-like megakaryocytes and platelet count ≥450 x10^9/L.
Megaloblastic change shows nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony with open chromatin in erythroid precursors and giant metamyelocytes, and corrects with B12/folate.
ET marrow has large hyperlobulated megakaryocytes without erythroid dysplasia or ≥15% ring sideroblasts.

ddx.dx: Copper deficiency / alcohol or drug-induced sideroblastic change
ddx.vs: Toxic/nutritional causes show cytoplasmic vacuolization of precursors and resolve with removal of the cause, without clonal thrombocytosis.

63574.recognize_zh: 粗箭頭處是巨大細胞，單一核分成多個相連的葉、染色質粗，胞質豐富並布滿細小嗜天青顆粒；細箭頭處緊鄰一大團紫色血小板，顯示成熟巨核細胞正在釋放血小板。
features: Very large cell with abundant cytoplasm and a single multilobated nucleus with interconnected lobes
Nuclear lobes with coarse, clumped chromatin; no nucleoli visible
Cytoplasm densely filled with fine azurophilic (purple) granules, with a paler granular peripheral zone
Large clump of platelets immediately adjacent to the cell margin (thin arrow), consistent with platelet release
Background of maturing granulocytes (bands, metamyelocytes), lymphocytes and red cells
63574.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (May-Grünwald-Giemsa) shows a large mature megakaryocyte with a single, multilobated nucleus composed of interconnected lobes with coarse chromatin, and abundant cytoplasm filled with fine azurophilic granules. A large aggregate of platelets lies adjacent to the cell border, consistent with platelet production. Surrounding marrow elements include normal-appearing maturing granulocytes and lymphocytes. Findings are consistent with a normal mature (platelet-producing) megakaryocyte.

ddx.vs: Osteoclasts have multiple completely separate, uniform oval nuclei with nucleoli, whereas megakaryocyte lobes are connected within a single nucleus.
Dysplastic megakaryocytes show non-lobated nuclei, widely separated round nuclei or micromegakaryocytes rather than a compact, connected multilobated nucleus.
ET megakaryocytes are giant with deeply hyperlobulated staghorn nuclei and are clustered and increased, which cannot be judged from a single normal-appearing cell.

exam.answer_en: Normal mature megakaryocyte — single multilobated nucleus, granular cytoplasm and adjacent platelet release
pearls_zh: 考法：粗箭頭指巨大細胞、細箭頭指旁邊紫色團塊，問兩者是什麼：成熟巨核細胞與正在釋出的血小板。
巨核細胞經 endomitosis 成為多倍體的單一分葉核；核葉彼此相連，是與多核破骨細胞區分的重點。
切片中巨核細胞可用 CD61、CD42b 或 Factor VIII-related antigen（vWF）IHC 標示，以評估數量、大小與叢聚。
血小板生成受 thrombopoietin 經 MPL 受體調控；TPO receptor agonist（romiplostim、eltrombopag）用於 ITP。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與破骨細胞混淆；巨核細胞為單一相連多葉核、無明顯核仁、胞質細顆粒並可見血小板釋出，破骨細胞則是多個分離且有核仁的核。

quiz.q: 細箭頭所指、緊鄰大細胞的紫色團塊是什麼？
quiz.a: 血小板團（成熟巨核細胞釋出的血小板）

63382.recognize_zh: 一個巨噬細胞（macrophage）周圍與胞質內散佈數十個 2–4 µm 的卵圓形小體，每個都有紫紅色核加旁邊一小點棒狀 kinetoplast，細胞破裂後散落在紅血球之間，這就是 Leishman-Donovan bodies。
features: Numerous small (2-4 um) oval amastigotes clustered within and around a ruptured macrophage
Each organism shows a purple nucleus with an adjacent smaller dot/rod-shaped kinetoplast
Amastigotes lack a surrounding capsule or halo
Macrophage with round nucleus and pale, vacuolated, partly disrupted cytoplasm
Scattered extracellular organisms from smearing artifact
Background RBCs and a neutrophil; no yeast budding forms
63382.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a histiocyte with pale, disrupted cytoplasm surrounded by numerous small oval intracellular and extracellular organisms. At high power, each organism measures approximately 2-4 um and contains a round nucleus and a separate small rod-like kinetoplast, without a capsule or budding. Findings are consistent with Leishmania amastigotes (Leishman-Donovan bodies), supporting visceral leishmaniasis.

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts show a clear halo/pseudocapsule and narrow-based budding but lack a kinetoplast.
Toxoplasma tachyzoites are crescent-shaped with a single nucleus and no kinetoplast.
Talaromyces yeasts divide by fission with a central transverse septum and have no kinetoplast.
Platelets are granular without an organized nucleus-kinetoplast pair and vary in shape.

exam.answer_en: Visceral leishmaniasis in marrow — numerous amastigotes with nucleus and rod-shaped kinetoplast in and around a macrophage
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指巨噬細胞內外小體要求說出「兩個點」各是什麼；答較大的是核，旁邊小棒狀的是 kinetoplast（粒線體 DNA）。
內臟型（kala-azar）主要由 L. donovani / L. infantum 引起：發燒、明顯脾腫大、全血球減少與多株性高 γ 球蛋白血症。
脾抽吸敏感度最高但有出血風險，骨髓抽吸較安全；rK39 快篩可輔助診斷，HIV 共感染者抗體可陰性。
治療首選 liposomal amphotericin B；內臟型可繼發 HLH，骨髓同時見噬血現象時需兩者都想到。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤判為 Histoplasma 或 Talaromyces；兩者為酵母菌、無 kinetoplast，Histoplasma 有透明暈與出芽，Talaromyces 以橫隔分裂。

quiz.q: 圖中每個小體都有「大點＋小棒」兩個構造，分別是什麼？
quiz.a: 大點為 nucleus，小棒為 kinetoplast

63318.recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓抹片中紅系前驅細胞體積大、染色質呈細緻篩網狀，並有雙核紅母細胞（A）、細胞間胞質橋接、核質發育不同步與巨大正母紅血球等紅系異生，加上旁邊的有絲分裂像，符合巨母紅血球性貧血。
features: Enlarged erythroid precursors with open, finely granular sieve-like chromatin and relatively mature, polychromatic cytoplasm
Binucleate erythroblasts, including a large cell with two separate round nuclei (A)
Closely apposed erythroblasts sharing cytoplasm consistent with cytoplasmic bridging, and large late erythroblasts with immature nuclei (labeled per legend)
Mitotic figure in a large erythroid precursor (lower panel, upper left)
Hemoglobinized cell with a small dense nucleus/nuclear fragment (C) and scattered orthochromatic cells
Hyperlobulated/giant myeloid element in the upper panel
63318.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at 100x (two composite fields) shows erythroid hyperplasia with megaloblastic change: precursors are enlarged with finely stippled, open chromatin that is immature relative to the polychromatic cytoplasm. Dyserythropoietic features include binucleate erythroblasts (A), cytoplasmic bridging between adjacent erythroblasts, nucleocytoplasmic asynchrony, macronormoblasts and detached nuclear fragments, labeled according to the original legend; the exact correspondence of some letters to cells is difficult to confirm on this image. A mitotic figure is present. Findings are consistent with megaloblastic erythropoiesis; B12/folate levels should be correlated before considering a myelodysplastic process.

ddx.vs: MDS lacks B12/folate deficiency, does not correct with replacement, and often shows ring sideroblasts, dysplastic megakaryocytes or clonal cytogenetic abnormalities.
CDA II shows predominantly binucleate late erythroblasts of normal size without megaloblastic chromatin or giant granulocytic precursors.
AEL is dominated by proerythroblasts with deeply basophilic, vacuolated cytoplasm rather than orderly but asynchronous maturation to late megaloblasts.

exam.answer_en: Megaloblastic anemia — enlarged erythroblasts with sieve-like chromatin, binucleation, cytoplasmic bridging and nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony
pearls_zh: 考法：指雙核紅母細胞（A）與胞質橋接問「dyserythropoiesis」，並追問這是否足以診斷 MDS——不行，必須先排除 B12/folate 缺乏與藥物。
其他巨母細胞變化原因：藥物（methotrexate、hydroxyurea、azathioprine、抗反轉錄病毒藥）、酒精，以及 nitrous oxide（使 B12 失去活性）。
B12 缺乏原因：pernicious anemia（autoimmune gastritis）、胃切除、迴腸末端切除或 Crohn disease、metformin、長期 PPI、全素飲食；Diphyllobothrium latum 為經典考點。
補充 B12 後網狀紅血球約在 1 週左右達高峰；治療初期細胞快速增生，需留意低血鉀。
exam.pitfall_zh: 雙核紅母細胞易被誤認為 CDA II 或 MDS；本圖細胞體積大、染色質呈篩網狀並伴巨大顆粒球前驅細胞，指向營養性巨母細胞變化。

quiz.q: 標示 A 的細胞為何種形態異常？在診斷 MDS 前必須先排除什麼？
quiz.a: Binucleate erythroblast（dyserythropoiesis）；B12/folate 缺乏與藥物影響

63254.recognize_zh: EDTA 抽血管上段內壁（紅色箭頭）附著一小團不規則、淡黃白至粉紅色的顆粒狀物質，與血液分離；在脂肪栓塞疑慮及分析儀出現血塊／干擾警示的情況下，這種管內顆粒提示脂肪顆粒（需與小血塊區分，可做濕片與脂肪染色確認）。
features: Photograph of the upper portion of a labeled EDTA whole-blood collection tube
Small, irregular, pale yellow-white to pinkish particulate aggregate adhering to the inner tube wall (red arrow)
Aggregate is separate from the blood column, with only faint red droplets on the wall
No gross fibrin strands or dark red clot visible in this view
63254.describe_en: Photograph of an EDTA whole-blood collection tube shows a small, irregular, pale yellow-white to pinkish particulate aggregate adhering to the inner wall of the upper tube (red arrow), separate from the blood column. No dark red fibrin clot is visible in this view. The gross appearance alone cannot distinguish lipid from a small pale clot or tissue fragment; however, in a patient with suspected fat embolism and analyzer interference flags, it is suggestive of fat particles, which should be confirmed by wet-mount examination and fat staining.

ddx.vs: A clot is typically red to dark red with fibrin strands and is associated with falsely low platelet counts, whereas fat is pale, refractile and floats, dissolving in lipid solvents and staining with Oil red O.

ddx.dx: Tissue or skin plug from venipuncture
ddx.vs: A tissue fragment is a single firm cored piece that shows epithelial or connective tissue on smear, rather than soft, oily globules.
Lipemia produces diffuse milky turbidity of the plasma rather than discrete particles adherent to the tube wall.

63190.recognize_zh: 高倍下小腺管由一層立方上皮圍成清楚管腔，核圓而溫和、無分裂象，外圍可見一層扁平的肌上皮細胞；CK 染色在腺管內層細胞強陽性，周圍間質沒有促纖維增生。
features: Small round to tubular glands lined by a single layer of cuboidal epithelial cells around open central lumina
Bland, uniform round nuclei with fine chromatin, no pleomorphism or mitoses
Attenuated outer layer of flattened (myoepithelial-type) cells surrounding several tubules
Glands arranged in a compact lobule within loose edematous stroma with fat; no desmoplasia
Cytokeratin immunostain (right) strongly positive in the luminal lining cells
63190.describe_en: High-power sections of the edge of a bone marrow trephine biopsy (H&E and cytokeratin) show a compact lobule of small tubular glands lined by uniform cuboidal cells with bland round nuclei and open lumina. An attenuated outer layer of flattened cells, consistent with myoepithelium, surrounds several tubules. There is no nuclear pleomorphism, mitotic activity, necrosis or desmoplastic stromal reaction. Cytokeratin strongly highlights the luminal epithelium. Findings are consistent with benign eccrine (sweat gland) ducts carried into the core during the biopsy procedure, not metastatic carcinoma.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma shows nuclear atypia, prominent nucleoli, mitoses, loss of a myoepithelial layer and desmoplastic stroma, none of which are present.
Breast metastases lack a preserved two-cell (luminal plus myoepithelial) layer and are distributed within the marrow rather than as a lobule at the core edge.
Capillaries are lined by flat endothelial cells that are keratin-negative, whereas these tubules have cuboidal keratin-positive lining cells.

63126.recognize_zh: 高倍下成片的大型異型細胞，核比組織球大、染色質呈泡狀、核膜不規則並可見核仁與核分裂像，取代正常造血，符合大 B 細胞淋巴瘤（濾泡性淋巴瘤轉化）侵犯骨髓。
features: Sheets of large atypical lymphoid cells, nuclei 2–3 times a small lymphocyte
Irregular, cleaved to multilobated nuclear contours
Vesicular chromatin with one or more distinct nucleoli (centroblast-like)
Moderate amount of pale cytoplasm; mitotic figure present
Scattered eosinophils and red cells; normal hematopoiesis effaced in this field
63126.describe_en: High-power view of the bone marrow biopsy shows diffuse sheets of large atypical lymphoid cells with irregular, focally cleaved or multilobated nuclei, vesicular chromatin, and one to several nucleoli. A mitotic figure is present, and scattered eosinophils are admixed. Normal hematopoietic elements are effaced in this field. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by a large B-cell lymphoma, in this case transformed follicular lymphoma, confirmed by B-cell and germinal center markers.

ddx.vs: Low-grade FL forms paratrabecular aggregates of small cleaved centrocytes with low Ki-67, whereas transformed disease shows sheets of large centroblast-like cells with mitoses.
Metastases form cohesive nests with desmoplasia and are keratin- or melanocytic-marker positive and CD45/CD20 negative.
cHL shows scattered Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells in a fibrotic mixed inflammatory background, CD30+/CD15+ with weak PAX5 and CD20 usually negative.
PTCL can have similar large pleomorphic cells with eosinophils but is CD3+ and negative for CD19/CD20/CD10.

62998.recognize_zh: CD25 免疫染色中，成束排列的紡錘形細胞呈細顆粒狀細胞質/膜陽性，分布區域與 CD117 陽性的紡錘形浸潤一致；肥大細胞異常表現 CD25 是系統性肥大細胞增生症的次要診斷標準。
features: Infiltrate of spindled cells arranged in streaming fascicles
Finely granular cytoplasmic and membranous CD25 staining in a large proportion of spindled cells
Staining intensity weaker and more granular than the companion CD117 stain
Elongated oval nuclei with fine chromatin in positive cells
Adjacent round hematopoietic cells largely negative
62998.describe_en: CD25 immunostain shows a streaming infiltrate of spindled cells with finely granular cytoplasmic and membranous positivity in a large proportion of the cells. The nuclei are elongated and oval, and adjacent round cells are largely negative. The distribution mirrors the CD117-positive spindled infiltrate. Findings are consistent with aberrant CD25 expression by atypical mast cells, supporting systemic mastocytosis.

ddx.vs: Reactive mast cells are CD25-negative, round and scattered rather than aggregated spindled cells.
Fibroblasts and stromal cells are spindled but negative for CD25, CD117 and tryptase.
Hairy cells are CD25+ but round with bean-shaped nuclei and co-express CD20/annexin A1/BRAF V600E, not CD117/tryptase.

62934.recognize_zh: 這是血球計數儀的報表比較：室溫時白血球 11.0 且分類欄位全顯示「:::::」、散佈圖左下有雜訊團；37°C 孵育 30 分鐘後白血球升到 17.5 並恢復五分類，提示嗜中性球凝集造成假性白血球偏低。
features: Room-temperature run: WBC 11.0 x10^3/uL with all differential parameters suppressed (':::::') and NRBC flag
Room-temperature scattergram: abnormal dense events in the lower-left region (arrow) with a poorly separated neutrophil cluster
Post-incubation run (37 °C, 30 min): WBC 17.5 x10^3/uL with full differential (NE 65.5%, LY 29.1%)
Post-incubation WBC histogram shows a restored broad granulocyte peak at ~150–300 fL and a well-defined neutrophil cluster on the scattergram
62934.describe_en: This figure compares automated hematology analyzer outputs from the same EDTA sample before and after warming. At room temperature, the WBC count is 11.0 x10^3/uL, the differential is suppressed, and the scattergram shows aberrant events in the low region with poor separation of the neutrophil population, while the histogram granulocyte peak is flattened. After incubation at 37 °C for 30 minutes, the WBC count rises to 17.5 x10^3/uL with a complete differential (neutrophils 11.5 x10^3/uL) and a distinct neutrophil cluster. The pattern indicates that neutrophil aggregates were not counted as individual cells at room temperature, consistent with in vitro neutrophil agglutination causing spurious leukopenia and differential failure.

ddx.vs: Platelet clumps lower the platelet count and may slightly raise the WBC count, whereas here the WBC count and differential are affected and correct on warming.
Red cell agglutination at room temperature causes falsely high MCV/MCHC and low RBC count, not suppression of the WBC differential.

ddx.dx: Nucleated red cells or lyse-resistant RBCs
ddx.vs: These produce spurious events near the lymphocyte region but do not resolve with 37 °C incubation.

62806.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片同時看到細染色質、核仁明顯的母細胞，以及帶多個圓形包涵體（Russell bodies/Mott cell）與雙核的漿細胞（箭頭）；腎絲球內有無結構的粉紅色沉積物，提示類澱粉沉積，三種病變並存。
features: Aspirate with a mixed population of large blasts (fine chromatin, prominent nucleoli, scant basophilic cytoplasm) and plasma cells (A, B)
Atypical plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, perinuclear hof, binucleation and multiple round cytoplasmic inclusions (Mott cell/Russell bodies, arrowheads)
Bone marrow biopsy with sheets of mononuclear cells including plasmacytoid forms (C, arrowhead)
Renal glomerulus with expanded mesangium and capillary walls by amorphous eosinophilic material (D), suggestive of amyloid; confirmation requires Congo red
Low image resolution limits precise quantification of each population
62806.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears show two distinct neoplastic populations: large blasts with finely dispersed chromatin, prominent nucleoli and scant basophilic cytoplasm, and atypical plasma cells, some binucleate or containing multiple Russell bodies (Mott cells). The core biopsy shows a dense infiltrate of mononuclear cells with plasmacytoid features. A renal biopsy shows glomeruli with mesangial and capillary wall expansion by amorphous eosinophilic material. Findings are suggestive of concurrent acute myeloid leukemia and plasma cell myeloma with renal amyloid deposition; confirmation by flow cytometry, CD138/light-chain studies and Congo red staining is needed.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell myeloma with plasmablastic morphology alone
ddx.vs: Plasmablasts retain eccentric nuclei and cytoplasmic immunoglobulin with CD138 expression, whereas myeloblasts are CD34/CD117/MPO positive and CD138 negative.
Reactive plasma cells are polytypic by kappa/lambda staining, while myeloma cells show light-chain restriction and aberrant CD56/CD19-negative phenotype.

ddx.dx: Light chain deposition disease or diabetic nodular glomerulosclerosis
ddx.vs: These glomerular lesions are Congo red negative without apple-green birefringence, unlike amyloid.

62806.stain: Wright-Giemsa, H&E, renal biopsy special stain

62742.recognize_zh: 同一抹片可見兩種 B 細胞：小型、染色質粗塊、胞質極少的 CLL 細胞，以及胞質豐富淡藍、邊緣毛絨狀的毛細胞；流式也分出 CD5+ kappa 與 CD5− CD11c+CD103+ lambda 兩群，基因重組呈兩個克隆峰，代表毛細胞白血病與 CLL 並存。
features: Small mature lymphocyte with clumped chromatin and scant cytoplasm (CLL-type) beside larger cells
Larger cells with oval nuclei, fine chromatin, and abundant pale blue cytoplasm with irregular hairy projections
Marrow biopsy: diffuse interstitial lymphoid infiltrate with spaced nuclei (fried-egg-like) on H&E
Immunostains (double and single stains, antibodies unlabeled) highlight distinct lymphoid populations
Flow: CD19+ CD5+ kappa-restricted population and separate CD19+ CD5- CD11c+ CD103+ lambda-restricted population
Clonality PCR shows distinct peaks consistent with two B-cell clones
62742.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two distinct lymphoid populations: small mature lymphocytes with clumped chromatin and scant cytoplasm, and larger cells with oval nuclei and abundant pale blue cytoplasm bearing fine hairy projections. The bone marrow biopsy shows a diffuse interstitial lymphoid infiltrate, and immunohistochemical double stains (antibodies not labeled in the image) delineate separate lymphoid populations. Flow cytometry identifies a CD19+ CD5+ kappa-restricted population and a separate CD5-negative, CD11c+ CD103+ lambda-restricted population, and immunoglobulin gene rearrangement analysis shows distinct clonal peaks. Findings are consistent with concurrent hairy cell leukemia and chronic lymphocytic leukemia.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia variant (splenic B-cell lymphoma with prominent nucleoli)
ddx.vs: HCL-variant cells have prominent nucleoli, are CD25- and annexin A1-negative, and lack BRAF V600E, and would not account for a second CD5+ kappa clone.
SMZL villous lymphocytes have polar short projections and are usually CD103- and CD25-negative with weak or absent CD11c.
Atypical CLL cells may be larger but share a single CD5+ light chain-restricted clone and lack CD103 and CD11c-bright hairy cells.
MCL cells are CD5-positive but cyclin D1- and SOX11-positive with irregular nuclei, not a CD5-negative CD103-positive hairy cell population.

62678.recognize_zh: 低倍 CD20 染色可見大量密集、形狀不規則、背靠背（back-to-back）排列的 CD20 強陽性結節，結節間 CD20 陰性的 T 細胞區較窄；整個淋巴結被腫瘤性濾泡取代。
features: Low power: numerous closely packed, irregular to serpiginous CD20-positive nodules
Nodules vary in size and shape, some confluent, with back-to-back arrangement
Strong diffuse membranous CD20 staining within nodules
Narrow interfollicular zones largely CD20 negative with scattered positive cells
No preserved normal nodal compartments evident
62678.describe_en: CD20 immunohistochemistry at low power highlights a lymph node replaced by numerous closely packed, irregularly shaped B-cell nodules with a back-to-back arrangement. The nodules stain strongly and diffusely for CD20 and are separated by narrow, predominantly CD20-negative interfollicular zones containing scattered B cells. The nodular B-cell expansion effacing the nodal architecture is consistent with follicular lymphoma, follicular pattern.

ddx.vs: Reactive follicles are better spaced, with preserved mantle zones and BCL2-negative germinal centers, rather than crowded back-to-back nodules throughout the node.
NMZL shows CD20-positive cells colonizing follicles and expanding interfollicular areas but lacks CD10/BCL6-positive neoplastic follicles.
MCL nodules are cyclin D1 and SOX11 positive and CD10 negative.

exam.answer_en: Follicular lymphoma, follicular pattern — CD20 highlights crowded back-to-back B-cell nodules effacing the lymph node
pearls_zh: 考法：低倍 CD20 問「結節是 B 還是 T 細胞」及結節分布（密集背靠背、取代整個淋巴結），據此偏向 FL 而非反應性增生。
CD20 只能證明 B 細胞結節，不能區分良惡性；需 CD10、BCL6（生發中心）、BCL2（異常表現）與 CD21/CD23（FDC 網）確認。
遺傳：t(14;18)(q32;q21) IGH::BCL2，見於大多數 nodal FL（尤其低級別）。
CD20 陽性是使用 rituximab／obinutuzumab 等 anti-CD20 治療的依據。
分類：WHO 5th 對 classic FL 不再強制分級、原 FL grade 3B 改稱 follicular large B-cell lymphoma；ICC 2022 仍保留 grade 1–2、3A、3B。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤為 reactive follicular hyperplasia；反應性濾泡間距較大、大小形狀不一、有 mantle zone 與 tingible body macrophages，且生發中心 BCL2 陰性。

quiz.q: 低倍 CD20 見淋巴結被密集背靠背的陽性結節取代，最可能診斷？最常見的染色體轉位？
quiz.a: Follicular lymphoma；t(14;18) IGH::BCL2

62614.recognize_zh: 體液細胞塊中的大型腫瘤細胞呈強烈的細胞膜與細胞質 CD30 陽性，呈環狀與核旁點狀著色，少數小型背景細胞不著色，符合 PEL 常見的 CD30 表現。
features: Loosely cohesive large round tumor cells in a proteinaceous background
Strong membranous and cytoplasmic CD30 staining, with ring-like and paranuclear dot (Golgi) accentuation
Majority of large cells positive
Occasional small negative nuclei (bystander lymphocytes/mesothelial or histiocytic cells)
Some diffuse background chromogen in fluid protein
62614.describe_en: Immunohistochemistry for CD30 on an effusion cell block shows strong membranous and cytoplasmic staining with Golgi accentuation in the majority of large, discohesive tumor cells, while scattered small background cells are negative. CD30 expression is frequent in primary effusion lymphoma and reflects its activated plasmablastic phenotype, but it is not specific. In a malignant effusion of large cells lacking B- and T-cell markers, with HHV8/LANA positivity, findings are consistent with primary effusion lymphoma.

ddx.dx: Anaplastic large cell lymphoma involving effusion
ddx.vs: ALCL expresses T-cell antigens and often ALK, and is HHV8-negative.
Hodgkin cells are CD30+/CD15+/PAX5 dim in a reactive background and rarely form effusion sheets, and are HHV8-negative.

ddx.dx: Embryonal carcinoma or other CD30-positive carcinoma
ddx.vs: Carcinomas are CD45-negative and keratin-positive, whereas PEL is often CD45-positive and keratin-negative.

ddx.dx: Fluid overload-associated large B-cell lymphoma (HHV8-negative effusion lymphoma)
ddx.vs: Morphologically similar but HHV8/LANA-negative and usually CD20-positive.

62550.recognize_zh: CD3 只標出散在或成群的反應性小 T 淋巴球，而背景中密集的中大型腫瘤細胞為陰性，說明腫瘤不是 T 細胞來源，符合 B 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Large neoplastic cells are CD3-negative
Scattered and loosely clustered CD3-positive small reactive T cells with membranous/cytoplasmic staining
Positive T cells concentrated in a band across the field, possibly perivascular or residual stroma
No aberrant CD3 staining in the tumor sheet
62550.describe_en: CD3 immunohistochemistry shows that the sheets of medium to large neoplastic cells are negative. Scattered and focally clustered small reactive T lymphocytes are positive, forming a band across the field. The absence of CD3 in the tumor cells, together with CD20 positivity, supports a B-cell lymphoma, consistent with the high-grade B-cell lymphoma in this case.

ddx.vs: PTCL shows CD3 positivity in the atypical large cells, not only in small background lymphocytes.
THRLBCL has abundant CD3-positive T cells surrounding rare large B cells, rather than sheets of CD3-negative tumor cells with few T cells.

62486.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中一顆嗜鹼性球（核被粗大深紫色顆粒遮蓋）緊鄰一顆分葉嗜中性球，背景血小板明顯增多；嗜鹼性球增多是 CML 加速期的重要線索。
features: Basophil with coarse, dark purple-black granules obscuring the nucleus
Adjacent segmented neutrophil with multiple lobes
Numerous platelets in the background, suggesting thrombocytosis
Red cells largely normocytic with mild anisocytosis
Few leukocytes in this particular field; overall count requires CBC and a lower power view
62486.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a basophil with coarse dark granules obscuring the nucleus next to a segmented neutrophil, in a background of abundant platelets. Red cells show mild anisocytosis without significant poikilocytosis. No blasts are identified in this field. In a patient with BCR::ABL1-positive CML, basophilia of at least 20% is a criterion for accelerated phase under WHO 2016, and a differential count of the whole smear is required to quantify it.

ddx.vs: Chronic phase also shows basophilia, but basophils are below 20% and blasts below 10%, which requires a full differential count rather than a single field.
ET has thrombocytosis without significant basophilia or left-shifted granulocytosis and is BCR::ABL1 negative.
PMF shows leukoerythroblastosis with teardrop cells and is BCR::ABL1 negative.

exam.answer_en: CML with basophilia — basophil with coarse dark granules and thrombocytosis in blood, a feature of disease progression (accelerated phase)
pearls_zh: 考法：指著顆粒遮蓋核的細胞問是嗜鹼性球，並追問 CML 周邊血嗜鹼性球 ≥20% 在 WHO 2016 與 ICC 2022 定義為 accelerated phase。
WHO 5th 已取消 accelerated phase，只分 chronic phase 與 blast phase，改以高風險特徵描述；ICC 2022 仍保留 AP（blasts 10–19% 或 basophils ≥20% 等）。
遺傳：t(9;22)(q34;q11.2) BCR::ABL1；追蹤以 RQ-PCR BCR::ABL1 定量（IS），分期進展時要查 ABL1 kinase domain 突變與額外染色體異常。
CML 中嗜鹼性球增加、血小板極度增多或脾臟持續腫大，提示對 TKI 反應不佳或疾病進展，需重新評估骨髓與治療。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把嗜鹼性球與毒性顆粒明顯的嗜中性球或肥大細胞混淆：嗜鹼性球顆粒粗大深紫黑、遮蓋分葉核；毒性顆粒較細、核清楚可見；肥大細胞核圓且多在組織中。

quiz.q: 圖中顆粒遮蓋細胞核的是什麼細胞？CML 中其比例達多少在 ICC 定義為 accelerated phase？
quiz.a: 嗜鹼性球（basophil）；周邊血 ≥20%

62422.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指的白血球細胞核偏向一側、細胞質淡粉紅並含顆粒，旁邊有一顆血小板；題目所述胞內成對球菌在此解析度下僅見少數細小深色點，無法清楚確認，判讀需在油鏡下直接看到成對的菌體才可靠，並需與毒性顆粒區分。
features: Arrowed leukocyte with eccentric, dense lobulated to reniform nucleus and pale pink granular cytoplasm
Tiny dark cytoplasmic dots at the cell edge, not clearly resolved as paired cocci at this magnification
Adjacent platelet overlapping the cell border
Second leukocyte on the right with indented nucleus and finely granular, vacuolated cytoplasm
Thick area of smear with overlapping, crenated red cells
62422.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a thick area with overlapping crenated red cells and two leukocytes. The arrowed cell has an eccentric dense nucleus and pale granular cytoplasm containing a few tiny dark dots; at this magnification and in this thick field they cannot be confidently resolved as paired cocci. The second leukocyte shows an indented nucleus with finely granular, vacuolated cytoplasm. Intracellular bacteria in circulating phagocytes would indicate high-grade bacteremia, but confirmation requires oil-immersion review in a thin area, Gram stain and blood cultures.

ddx.vs: Toxic granules are uniformly distributed, fine and purple throughout the cytoplasm, whereas bacteria are discrete, uniform, paired or chained bodies often within a clear phagocytic vacuole.
An overlapping platelet shows a pale hyalomere with central granules and lies in a different focal plane, rather than distinct intracytoplasmic cocci.
Precipitate is irregular in size, refractile and also lies over red cells and background, not confined to leukocyte cytoplasm.
Döhle bodies are pale blue-grey peripheral cytoplasmic patches rather than dark, sharply defined paired dots.

62358.recognize_zh: 密集排列、核不規則的淋巴母細胞中，許多細胞呈現中度到強度的膜狀 CD4 棕色染色，強度不一，符合皮質型胸腺細胞階段的 T 淋巴母細胞表現型。
features: Diffuse sheet of medium-sized cells with high N:C ratio and irregular, focally indented nuclei
Variable (weak to strong) membranous and cytoplasmic CD4 staining in many tumor cells
Heterogeneous staining intensity with admixed negative cells
Occasional strongly positive cells, possibly admixed histiocytes
62358.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD4 on a diffuse lymphoblastic infiltrate shows variable, moderate to strong membranous staining in a large proportion of the tumor cells, with admixed negative cells. The cells are medium-sized with irregular nuclei and scant cytoplasm on the counterstain. Together with CD3, TdT and CD1a, the CD4 expression supports T-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma, with the CD4/CD8 profile helping to assign the stage of thymic maturation.

ddx.vs: BPDCN is CD4+ but also CD56+, CD123+, TCL1+ and negative for CD3 and TdT in most cases.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation (myeloid sarcoma)
ddx.vs: Monocytic blasts are CD4+ but express lysozyme, CD68/CD163 and CD33, and lack CD3 and CD1a.
Mature T-cell lymphomas are often CD4+ but are TdT-negative and CD1a-negative with a pleomorphic rather than blastic chromatin pattern.

62294.recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞 CD4/CD8 雙參數散佈圖（淋巴球 gate）：CD8 陽性族群佔 51.13%、CD4 陽性僅 26.59%，CD4:CD8 比例倒置（約 0.5），配合臨床與 EBER 結果支持全身性 EBV 陽性 T 細胞淋巴瘤（多為 CD8 陽性）。
features: Two-parameter dot plot of CD4 FITC versus CD8 PE gated on lymphocytes
CD8+CD4- population 51.13% forming a tight, bright CD8 cluster
CD4+CD8- population 26.59%, relatively dim CD4 intensity
CD4-CD8- population 21.28% (includes B cells, NK cells and any double-negative T cells)
CD4+CD8+ events only 1.00%; CD4:CD8 ratio approximately 0.5 (inverted)
62294.describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis of peripheral blood lymphocytes displayed as a CD4 versus CD8 dot plot shows 51.13% CD8-positive/CD4-negative cells, 26.59% CD4-positive/CD8-negative cells, 21.28% double-negative events and 1.00% double-positive events. The CD4:CD8 ratio is therefore inverted at approximately 0.5, with a prominent, homogeneous bright CD8-positive population. This plot alone does not establish clonality, since an inverted ratio also occurs in reactive viral responses; correlation with T-cell antigen loss, TCR clonality studies and EBER in situ hybridization is required. In context, the findings support an expanded CD8-positive T-cell population consistent with systemic EBV-positive T-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Reactive infections also invert the CD4:CD8 ratio but show polyclonal TCR (Vbeta repertoire or PCR) and preserved pan-T-cell antigens.

ddx.dx: Chronic active EBV disease of T-cell type
ddx.vs: CAEBV shows EBV-infected T or NK cells with a more indolent course, separated by clinical duration, clonality and histologic features rather than by this plot.
T-LGL is a clonal CD8+ CD57+ population with granular lymphocyte morphology, EBV negative, and often STAT3 mutated.
HIV causes an inverted ratio mainly through CD4 depletion, identified by serology and absolute CD4 counts rather than an expanded clonal CD8 population.

62038.recognize_zh: 淋巴結免疫染色（棕色）中，散在的大型細胞呈清楚的環狀膜染色，細胞核大而淡、形狀不規則，周圍是大量陰性的小淋巴球；這種「大型 B 細胞散在於小淋巴球背景」的分佈符合 NLPHL 的 LP 細胞（lymphocyte predominant cells）。
features: Scattered large cells with strong circumferential membranous and cytoplasmic staining (DAB)
Large positive cells have large pale vesicular, irregular or lobated nuclei
Some smaller positive cells, focally clustered at the lower right edge
Background of numerous small round unstained lymphocytes
No sheet-like confluence of large positive cells in this field
62038.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain (chromogen DAB; antigen not labeled, pattern suggests a B-cell marker such as CD20) of a lymph node shows numerous scattered large cells with strong membranous staining set in a background of predominantly negative small lymphocytes. The large cells have irregular, vesicular nuclei. Smaller positive cells are present focally. The pattern of scattered large B cells within a small-lymphocyte background is consistent with LP cells of nodular lymphocyte-predominant Hodgkin lymphoma with a variant (T-cell-rich/extranodular) pattern; the antigen and full architecture should be confirmed in the referenced case.

ddx.vs: THRLBCL shows diffuse architecture without residual follicular dendritic cell meshworks or small B-cell-rich nodules, whereas NLPHL retains nodular CD21+ meshworks with small B cells.
HRS cells of cHL are CD30+/CD15+ with weak or absent CD20 and PAX5 dim, while LP cells are strongly CD20+, OCT2+, BOB1+ and CD30/CD15 negative.
PTGC lacks LP cells; scattered large atypical CD20+ cells rimmed by PD1+ T cells favor NLPHL.

61974.recognize_zh: CD8 免疫染色中，只有散在的小淋巴球呈細胞膜陽性，佔浸潤細胞的少數，其餘大多為陰性；配合 CD4 染色大部分陽性，顯示 CD4 遠多於 CD8，符合 CD4+ 小/中型 T 細胞增生性疾病。
features: Dense lymphoid infiltrate of small to medium-sized cells
CD8 membranous staining limited to scattered small lymphocytes
CD8-positive cells are a clear minority of the infiltrate
Positive cells are evenly interspersed without clustering
Supports a CD4-predominant T-cell population when compared with CD4
61974.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD8 on a skin biopsy shows only scattered small lymphocytes with membranous staining, representing a minority of the dense dermal infiltrate, while most small to medium-sized cells are negative. Compared with the CD4 stain, the infiltrate is CD4-predominant. The CD8-positive cells are consistent with a reactive cytotoxic T-cell component. Findings support primary cutaneous CD4-positive small/medium T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder rather than a CD8-positive cytotoxic process.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous acral CD8-positive lymphoproliferative disorder
ddx.vs: The acral CD8+ entity shows a monotonous CD8-positive (not CD4-positive) medium-sized T-cell infiltrate, typically on the ear or acral sites.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous CD8-positive aggressive epidermotropic cytotoxic T-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: This lymphoma has diffuse CD8 and cytotoxic marker positivity with marked epidermotropism, necrosis and ulceration.
SPTCL shows CD8+ βF1+ cytotoxic cells rimming adipocytes in the subcutis rather than a dermal CD4-predominant infiltrate.

61910.recognize_zh: Ki-67染色下，皮下脂肪與真皮深層的淋巴樣浸潤中只有散在的細胞核呈棕色陽性，估計占浸潤細胞的少數（約一至二成），多數細胞為藍色陰性；增生指數不高，與HV-LPD多呈低至中度增生、非高度侵襲性淋巴瘤的表現相符。
features: Nuclear Ki-67 staining in scattered cells within a lymphoid infiltrate among subcutaneous adipocytes
Positive nuclei represent a minority of the infiltrate (visually roughly 10-20%)
Positive cells include small and medium-sized nuclei, some with irregular contours
Majority of infiltrating and stromal nuclei are negative (hematoxylin counterstain)
No sheets or clusters of proliferating large cells
61910.describe_en: Ki-67 immunohistochemistry on the subcutaneous and deep dermal lymphoid infiltrate shows nuclear staining in scattered cells, representing a minority of the infiltrate (visually estimated at approximately 10-20% in this field). The positive nuclei are small to medium-sized and are not clustered in sheets. The proliferation index is low to moderate. This pattern is compatible with hydroa vacciniforme lymphoproliferative disorder and argues against a high-grade aggressive lymphoma, although Ki-67 alone does not establish the diagnosis.

ddx.vs: ENKTL typically shows a high Ki-67 index (often above 50%) with EBER-positive pleomorphic cells and necrosis.
SPTCL shows a high Ki-67 index concentrated in atypical cells rimming adipocytes, which is not seen in this field.
Reactive panniculitis also shows a low Ki-67 index but lacks EBER-positive cytotoxic cells and has a mixed inflammatory background.

61846.recognize_zh: 高倍下大量淡染、細空泡狀的泡沫組織球，核小而圓、無明顯異型，間夾纖細的膠原纖維；典型的黃色瘤樣（xanthomatous）組織球浸潤，符合 Erdheim-Chester 病。
features: Sheets of large histiocytes with abundant pale, finely vacuolated foamy cytoplasm
Small, round to oval, hyperchromatic, bland nuclei
Indistinct cell borders with delicate intervening collagen fibers
Scattered spindle fibroblasts and small vessels
No multinucleated giant cells, atypia, or mitoses in this field
61846.describe_en: High-power view shows a diffuse infiltrate of histiocytes with abundant pale, finely vacuolated foamy cytoplasm and small bland round to oval nuclei, separated by delicate collagen fibers with scattered fibroblasts and small vessels. No significant nuclear atypia, mitotic figures, emperipolesis, or eosinophils are seen. Findings are consistent with a xanthomatous histiocytic infiltrate, compatible with Erdheim-Chester disease in the appropriate immunophenotypic, radiologic, and molecular context.

ddx.vs: Xanthomas are morphologically similar but lack systemic involvement and MAPK pathway mutations and are linked to lipid disorders.
LCH cells have eosinophilic non-foamy cytoplasm with grooved nuclei and CD1a/Langerin positivity.

ddx.dx: Clear cell renal cell carcinoma (in retroperitoneal lesions)
ddx.vs: RCC cells have sharp cell borders, glycogen-rich clear cytoplasm, and keratin/PAX8 positivity rather than CD68/CD163.

ddx.dx: Atypical mycobacterial or Whipple infection with foamy macrophages
ddx.vs: Infection-associated foamy macrophages contain organisms demonstrable by AFB or PAS-D stains.

61718.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 CD4 免疫染色：浸潤的中型腫瘤細胞幾乎全面呈細胞膜與胞質棕色陽性，強度彌漫一致，僅少數細胞為陰性；芽細胞廣泛表現 CD4 是 BPDCN 的核心標記之一。
features: Diffuse, strong membranous and cytoplasmic CD4 staining in the great majority of infiltrating cells
Intermediate-sized cells with round to oval nuclei and fine chromatin on counterstain
Scattered CD4-negative cells with blue nuclei interspersed
Occasional cells with more intense ring-like membranous staining
Adipocyte spaces indicating residual marrow architecture
61718.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD4 on a bone marrow biopsy shows diffuse, strong membranous and cytoplasmic positivity in the great majority of infiltrating intermediate-sized cells, with only scattered negative cells. The positive cells have round to oval nuclei with fine chromatin and are arranged in sheets between adipocytes. Diffuse CD4 expression by a blastic infiltrate lacking T-cell and myeloid markers is characteristic of blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm. Findings support BPDCN together with CD56, CD123 and TCF4 positivity.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Monocytic blasts are CD4-positive but also express lysozyme, CD163/CD14 and CD68 strongly, and are CD123/TCF4-negative or weak.

ddx.dx: T-lymphoblastic lymphoma/leukemia or peripheral T-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: T-cell neoplasms are CD4-positive with CD3 (and TdT in T-ALL), whereas BPDCN is CD3-negative.
Histiocytic sarcoma has large pleomorphic cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm expressing CD163/CD68 and is CD123/CD56-negative.

61654.recognize_zh: 中低倍骨髓切片可見骨小樑間幾乎完全被單一形態、胞質淡染至顆粒狀的細胞片狀取代，脂肪消失並伴有明顯出血，符合 APL 骨髓全面浸潤的表現。
features: Markedly hypercellular marrow (near 100%) with loss of fat
Diffuse monotonous sheets of cells with moderate pale-to-granular cytoplasm and distinct cell borders
Effacement of normal trilineage hematopoiesis; megakaryocytes difficult to identify
Prominent interstitial hemorrhage
Intact bony trabeculae
61654.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at low-to-intermediate power shows a markedly hypercellular marrow with near-complete loss of fat. The intertrabecular spaces are effaced by diffuse, monotonous sheets of cells with moderate amounts of pale to finely granular cytoplasm and distinct cell borders, with marked reduction of normal hematopoietic elements. Areas of interstitial hemorrhage are present. Findings are consistent with involvement by acute leukemia and, in context, with acute promyelocytic leukemia; confirmation of PML::RARA is required.

ddx.vs: Most AMLs show sheets of blasts with scant cytoplasm; APL cells have more abundant granular cytoplasm, but genetic confirmation of PML::RARA is required.
HCL shows a 'fried-egg' infiltrate of cells with widely spaced oval/reniform nuclei and clear cytoplasm, with CD20/annexin A1/BRAF V600E positivity and MPO negativity.
Carcinoma forms cohesive nests with desmoplastic stroma and is cytokeratin-positive rather than diffuse discohesive sheets.

61590.recognize_zh: 肝細胞索之間的竇狀隙明顯被撐開，裡面塞滿混合的造血細胞：核圓或卵圓、染色質細緻的未成熟髓系/單核系細胞、深染小圓核的紅血球前驅細胞與帶狀或分節核的中性球；這種竇狀隙浸潤型態符合 JMML 侵犯肝臟。
features: Hepatic sinusoids markedly distended by a hematopoietic infiltrate between preserved hepatocyte plates
Immature myelomonocytic cells with round to oval nuclei, fine chromatin and small nucleoli
Admixed erythroid precursors with small, round, hyperchromatic nuclei
Scattered band and segmented granulocytes
Hepatocytes with granular pale cytoplasm and intact architecture
61590.describe_en: H&E section of liver shows preserved hepatocyte plates with markedly distended sinusoids containing a mixed hematopoietic infiltrate. The infiltrate includes immature myelomonocytic cells with round to oval nuclei, fine chromatin and small nucleoli, admixed with erythroid precursors bearing small dense nuclei and scattered band and segmented granulocytes. There are no sheets of blasts and no discrete mass. In the appropriate clinical and molecular context, findings are consistent with sinusoidal hepatic involvement by juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Trilineage with megakaryocytes and erythroid islands and no monocytic predominance; clinical setting (anemia, marrow fibrosis, neonate) and absence of a clonal RAS-pathway lesion distinguish it.
Also sinusoidal, but cells are monotonous medium-sized CD3+ γδ T cells without maturing granulocytes or erythroid precursors.
Sinusoids contain activated histiocytes with hemophagocytosis rather than a maturing myelomonocytic proliferation.

ddx.dx: Transient abnormal myelopoiesis / AMKL in Down syndrome
ddx.vs: Infiltrate is dominated by megakaryoblasts with associated hepatic fibrosis.

61526.recognize_zh: 背景小至中型淋巴球之間散佈許多大細胞，細胞質在固定後收縮成透亮空腔、核呈多葉狀，典型的腔隙細胞（lacunar cell）；右上方另見一個核濃縮深染、周圍有空暈的木乃伊細胞（mummified cell），提示結節硬化型古典何杰金淋巴瘤。
features: Numerous large lacunar cells with retracted, clear to finely vacuolated cytoplasm sitting in empty spaces
Lacunar cell nuclei are lobulated/folded with delicate chromatin and small nucleoli
Occasional mummified (apoptotic) HRS cell with a condensed, hyperchromatic nucleus in a clear halo
Background of small to medium lymphocytes with round to slightly irregular nuclei
Thin strands of eosinophilic collagen between cell groups
61526.describe_en: Lymph node section shows a cellular infiltrate in which numerous large lacunar cells are distributed among a background of small to medium lymphocytes, with thin collagen strands. The lacunar cells have abundant retracted, clear cytoplasm and lobulated nuclei with small nucleoli; a mummified cell with a condensed hyperchromatic nucleus is also present. Sheets of monomorphic large atypical cells or necrosis are not seen in this field. Findings are consistent with classical Hodgkin lymphoma, nodular sclerosis subtype.

ddx.vs: ALCL forms cohesive sheets of hallmark cells with horseshoe nuclei and is CD30+/ALK+ or ALK- with T-cell antigens and no CD15, rather than scattered lacunar cells in a reactive background.
LP (popcorn) cells lack the retraction artifact of lacunar cells and are CD20+/CD45+, CD30-/CD15-, in a nodular small B-cell background without collagen bands.
Its scattered large cells are CD20+ B cells in a T-cell and histiocyte background, without lacunar retraction or sclerosis.
Metastases form cohesive clusters and are keratin or S100/SOX10 positive, whereas HRS cells are CD30+/CD15+ and keratin negative.

exam.answer_en: Classic Hodgkin lymphoma, nodular sclerosis — numerous lacunar cells plus a mummified HRS cell in a small lymphocyte background
pearls_zh: 考法：考官會分別指 lacunar cell 與 mummified cell（核濃縮深染、周圍空暈的凋亡 HRS 細胞），要你說出兩者都是 HRS 細胞的變異型。
HRS 細胞變異型常考名單：classic RS cell（雙核鏡像）、mononuclear Hodgkin cell、lacunar cell（NS 型）、mummified cell；LP（popcorn）cell 則屬於 NLPHL。
HRS 細胞在腫瘤中通常只佔少數，大部分是反應性 T 細胞、嗜酸性球、組織球與漿細胞，這是 CHL 與多數非何杰金淋巴瘤的根本差異。
確診仍須 IHC：CD30+、CD15+、PAX5 弱陽性、CD45 陰性。
exam.pitfall_zh: Mummified cell 易被誤認為凋亡細胞或 tingible-body macrophage 內碎屑；它保有 HRS 細胞的大體積與濃縮核輪廓，且伴隨其他 lacunar/HRS 細胞出現。

quiz.q: 圖右上核濃縮深染、周圍有空暈的大細胞叫什麼？它與 lacunar cell 共同屬於哪一種細胞的變異型？
quiz.a: Mummified cell；Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg（HRS）細胞

61462.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 H&E 顯示明顯高細胞性骨髓，三系造血仍存在，另有許多小至中型淋巴樣細胞散布並沿竇狀隙線狀排列；H&E 上浸潤很隱微，需要 CD3 等免疫染色凸顯竇內分布才能確認肝脾 T 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Markedly hypercellular marrow core with reduced fat
Trilineage hematopoiesis present, including megakaryocytes and erythroid islands
Increased small to medium lymphoid cells with dark, round nuclei, some arranged in subtle linear rows along sinusoids
No discrete lymphoid aggregates or granulomas
Intrasinusoidal pattern is subtle on H&E; peripheral blood clot/hemorrhage at upper left
61462.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E) shows a markedly hypercellular marrow with persistent trilineage hematopoiesis. There is an increased population of small to medium-sized lymphoid cells with dark nuclei, some aligned in linear arrays suggestive of an intrasinusoidal distribution, without discrete nodular aggregates. The infiltrate is subtle and cannot be confidently characterized on H&E alone at this magnification. Immunohistochemistry for CD3, CD8, TIA-1 and TCR delta would be required; in that context the findings are consistent with marrow involvement by hepatosplenic T-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Reactive marrow lacks a clonal, sinusoid-restricted CD3+ infiltrate and TCR clonality.
Also intrasinusoidal on CD8 staining but the cells are CD8+ alpha-beta T cells with granzyme B positivity and no i(7q).
Hypercellularity is driven by atypical megakaryocytes and granulocytic expansion rather than an increased lymphoid infiltrate.

61398.recognize_zh: EBER 原位雜交中，許多大小不一的細胞核呈深藍黑色訊號，包括幾顆大型不規則核的大細胞，背景其他細胞為淡紅色對比染色；證實這些大細胞帶有 EBV，支持 EBV 陽性黏膜皮膚潰瘍。
features: Strong dark blue nuclear EBER signal in numerous cells
Positive cells range from small to large, including large irregular and lobated nuclei corresponding to giant cells
Signal is confined to nuclei with clean cytoplasm
Many background cells are negative with pink nuclear fast red counterstain
61398.describe_en: In situ hybridization for EBV-encoded RNA (EBER) shows strong nuclear positivity in numerous cells, including the large atypical giant cells as well as a spectrum of smaller and intermediate-sized cells.
